usageGuidelines: Use this tool for historical issuer reports when the user asks for a specific ATLAS-7 date.
Do not mix latest company-report fields into a historical calculation-history answer.
Treat high alpha scores and low stress as diligence screens, not recommendations.

description: Use this read-only tool when agents need the complete ATLAS-7 calculation bundle for an issuer and source_date. It assembles one calculation-history row from the existing ATLAS-7 precomputed surfaces: covenant stress, company fundamentals, peer ranking, alpha signals, alpha score breakdown, market regime context, SPECTRA inputs, quality flags, provenance, source fields, and hashes. Parameters: source_date replays one YYYY-MM-DD ATLAS-7 slice; source_date_from/source_date_to can page recent slices; ticker or CIK narrows to one issuer; mode=compact by default and full includes source_fields_json. Behavior: read-only and idempotent; it has no destructive side effects and performs no wallet, settlement, or trading actions. Use this before historical report rendering so agents do not mix latest-only fields into a historical answer.

cik.description: Optional CIK filter. Bare digits or CIK-prefixed digits are accepted.

limit.description: Maximum calculation rows to return. Defaults to 25 and is capped at 100 through MCP.

mode.description: Optional response mode: compact or full. Compact omits source_fields_json.

source_date.description: Optional exact ATLAS-7 source date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to latest when no range is supplied.

source_date_from.description: Optional inclusive source-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_to.description: Optional inclusive source-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ticker.description: Optional issuer ticker, for example MSTR.

name: deltasignal_atlas7_calculation_history

stress_50pct.description: Stress value under 50 percent stress assumptions.
